title: Accepted gaps of this repository's governed specs
description: What the gate (`forge governance check`) lets through: a check that fails or did not run, for a named spec or for every spec of a framework, until the backlog item named is closed. An entry counts only while the owner's approval covers its exact content (`forge governance gap-approve`). An entry that covers nothing, or whose backlog item is closed, stops the gate, so the file only shrinks without the owner. See forge-core/docs/fxts/README.md, "The gate".

gaps.reason: No run compares an API spec with the route it describes: the runner checks the spec against itself. The comparison with the app built in process is FB-269.
No check compares an adapter spec with the module's code; the live checks are not implemented.
No run compares the transport spec with the proto or the servicer; the runner never opens a proto file.
The conformance kit cannot drive the interim MES bridge, which runs in another process and language.

The owner has not approved the interim MES bridge's module spec; it waits until the kit can drive the bridge.
The spec waives time-keeping requirements, and such a waiver counts only in a spec the owner has approved.
The scanner module has no sample events for the conformance kit, so its time check has never run.
